final: WITH patient_avgs AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALB IS NOT NULL AND l.TP IS NOT NULL THEN l.ALB - l.TP END) AS alb_tp, AVG(CASE WHEN l.APTT IS NOT NULL AND l.PT IS NOT NULL THEN l.APTT - l.PT END) AS aptt_pt FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_avgs AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_tp) AS alb_tp, AVG(aptt_pt) AS aptt_pt FROM patient_avgs GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_pt) AS mean_aptt_pt FROM sex_avgs) SELECT AVG(s.alb_tp) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(s.aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(s.aptt_pt - o.mean_aptt_pt) AS avg_excess_over_sex_mean FROM sex_avgs AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.aptt_pt > o.mean_aptt_pt
